sap_ontology.title: Krusmaster/sap-ontology README: header/item pairs VBAK -> VBAP (join on VBELN) and VBAP -> VBEP (join on VBELN, POSNR)
sap_ontology.note: Used only where it agrees with SAP's public documentation of the same tables.

tables.name: KNA1
tables.note: In S/4HANA customers are maintained as business partners; KNA1 is still the customer table that sales documents point at.

tables.name: KNVV
tables.note: One row per customer and sales area (sales organization, distribution channel, division).

tables.name: MARA
tables.note: MATNR is 18 characters in ECC and 40 in S/4HANA; numeric material numbers are stored with leading zeros.

tables.name: MAKT
tables.note: One row per material and language: filter on SPRAS before joining, or every order line is repeated once per language.

tables.name: VBAK
tables.note: Orders, quotations, contracts and returns share this table; AUART (and VBTYP) tell them apart.

tables.name: VBEP
tables.note: Several schedule lines per item: a join of VBAP and VBEP repeats the item's NETWR once per schedule line.

tables.name: VBUK
tables.note: ECC only: in S/4HANA the status fields moved into VBAK, LIKP and VBRK.

tables.name: VBUP
tables.note: ECC only: in S/4HANA the status fields moved into VBAP, LIPS and VBRP.

tables.name: VBPA
tables.en: Partners of sales, delivery and billing documents
tables.note: One row per document, item and partner function. POSNR 000000 holds the partners of the whole document. PARVW is the internal function code (AG sold-to, WE ship-to, RE bill-to, RG payer; shown as SP, SH, BP, PY in English logons). Sold-to, ship-to and payer may be three different customers.

tables.name: VBRK
tables.note: Cancellations and credit memos are billing documents too; FKART and the cancellation flag decide whether to count them.

tables.name: VBRP
tables.note: The currency of an item amount is the header's WAERK: join VBRK before converting or adding across documents.

tables.name: VBFA
tables.key_note: The key as documented for ECC; S/4HANA simplified the table and its key may differ by release (not verified).
tables.note: A link table between any preceding and any subsequent document: an order item can have several deliveries and a delivery can serve several orders. VBTYP_V and VBTYP_N say which kind of document each side is.

relationships.condition: VBUK also holds the status of deliveries and billing documents; only rows of sales documents find a VBAK row.
VBUP also holds item status of deliveries and billing documents; only rows of sales documents find a VBAP row.
VGBEL/VGPOS name the reference document; for deliveries created from sales orders that is the order item. Deliveries without an order reference leave them empty.
Only for delivery-related billing; for order-related billing VGBEL/VGPOS name the order item instead.
Customer partners only; contact persons, vendors and employees as partners use other columns and leave KUNNR empty.
VBPA also holds the partners of deliveries and billing documents; only rows of sales documents find a VBAK row.
Only rows whose preceding document is a sales document (VBTYP_V); VBFA links any document to any other.
Only rows whose subsequent document is a delivery (VBTYP_N).
Only rows whose subsequent document is a billing document (VBTYP_N).
Only status rows of deliveries find a LIKP row.
Only status rows of billing documents find a VBRK row.
Only item status rows of deliveries find a LIPS row.
Only item status rows of billing documents find a VBRP row.
Only partner rows of deliveries find a LIKP row.
Only partner rows of billing documents find a VBRK row.
Only item-level partner rows (POSNR not 000000) of sales documents find a VBAP row.
Only item-level partner rows of deliveries find a LIPS row.
Only item-level partner rows of billing documents find a VBRP row.
Header level, subsequent side: only rows whose subsequent document is a sales document (VBTYP_N), such as an order created from a quotation.
Header level, subsequent side: only rows whose subsequent document is a delivery (VBTYP_N).
Header level, subsequent side: only rows whose subsequent document is a billing document (VBTYP_N).

traps.title: MANDT in every join
traps.text: Every client-specific table starts its key with the client (MANDT). One database can hold several clients, so a join on VBELN alone can pair an order of one client with an item of another. The pack's keys and relationships always carry MANDT; when an extract has dropped the column, the pack drops it on both sides and says so.

traps.title: Header amounts and item amounts are different levels
traps.text: VBAK.NETWR is the net value of the whole document, VBAP.NETWR that of one item. Summing VBAK.NETWR over a join with VBAP counts each order once per item (Krusgraph's 'the total that doubles' check, amounts.py); summing VBAP.NETWR over a join with VBEP counts each item once per schedule line. Sum each amount on its own table.

traps.title: Currency per document
traps.text: NETWR is in the document currency WAERK, which can differ from document to document. Adding NETWR across documents without converting adds different currencies. VBRP has no currency of its own; its amounts are in VBRK.WAERK.

traps.title: Leading zeros in number columns
traps.text: Document, customer and material numbers are text columns; numeric values are stored right-aligned with leading zeros (VBELN '0000012345'). A join with a source that stores 12345 as an integer or without zeros finds nothing. Pad or strip on one side, the same way everywhere.

traps.title: VBFA is many-to-many
traps.text: An order item can be delivered in several deliveries and a delivery can serve several orders; the same holds between deliveries and invoices. VBFA records each pair. Joining orders to invoices through VBFA multiplies rows on both sides: aggregate on one side first, and filter VBTYP_V/VBTYP_N to the document kinds you mean.

traps.title: Sold-to, ship-to and payer may differ
traps.text: VBAK.KUNNR is the sold-to party. The ship-to party and the payer are rows of VBPA (PARVW), and on deliveries and billing documents in LIKP.KUNNR and VBRK.KUNRG. 'Revenue per customer' needs a choice of which of them.

traps.title: Text tables have one row per language
traps.text: MAKT has one row per material and language; filter SPRAS before joining.
